action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Escalate. Bile acid malabsorption: reject if symptomatic and under a consultant. Colitis: may be safe if resolved. Gallbladder polyp: OK if benign with no gallstones. Splenectomy: check reason (post-trauma usually OK). Bowel removed: confirm no stoma.

rationale: Escalate. Fasting triglycerides above 4.5 mmol/L → do not prescribe (pancreatitis risk). Confirm the test was fasted; if not, ask for a fasted repeat.

name: Triglyceride result
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Triglycerides above 4.5 mmol/L are flagged for a fasted check.

name: Solitary kidney / transplant / cysts

rationale: Escalate: OK if eGFR >30 in the last 6 months. Kidney cysts: OK if not PKD and eGFR >30.

name: Autoimmune disease or DMARD
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision
rationale: Escalate. Likely safe if stable for 6 months, not on steroids or NTI medicines, and the rheumatology team is aware (recent clinic letter recommended). Oral methotrexate is an NTI exclusion.

name: HIV
action_label: PRESCRIBER REVIEW — record decision

name: Anaemia
